title: Deterministic Projectiles
description: This plugin removes random spread from projectiles so you can pearl catch every time
body:
# DeterministicProjectiles

Removes the random spread of projectiles, like PvP servers so you can pearl catch every time.

A projectile thrown from the same location always lands on the same location no RNG.

## What it covers

- Ender pearls
- Snowballs
- Eggs
- Wind charges
- Splash / lingering potions
- Tridents

Bow and crossbow arrows are left vanilla on purpose (charge + multishot).

###### it's vibe coded btw
